ones = [0] * 20
for i in range(1, 17):
    ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def count_ones(n, i):
    if n == 0 or i == 0:
        return 0
    current_block = ones[i]
    max_full_blocks = n // current_block
    result = max_full_blocks * i
    remainder = n % current_block
    if remainder == 0:
        return result
    option1 = i + count_ones(ones[i] - remainder, i - 1)
    option2 = count_ones(remainder, i - 1)
    return result + min(option1, option2)

n = int(input())
print(count_ones(n, 16))
